slideLayout.chart.tip: Edit the picked chart's series names, categories, values and chart type in a grid
slideLayout.chart.title: Edit chart data
slideLayout.chart.sub: Columns are series, rows are categories. Saving changes the values in the chart and its embedded workbook together.
slideLayout.chart.badNumber: Red cells are not numbers. Fix them to apply.
slideLayout.chart.pieFirst: A pie chart draws only the first series.
slideLayout.chart.save.noWorkbook: The chart's embedded workbook was not found, so only the values stored in the chart changed. A presentation program's Edit Data may show the old values
slideLayout.chart.save.workbookAnew: The chart's embedded workbook was written anew (it holds content such as array or shared formulas that cannot be changed cell by cell). Every sheet's values are kept, but the workbook's tables, formatting and some formulas are gone
